design_rationale:
[0 · Step 0 worklog — draw and scope]
draw_counts.py --task 0 printed: {"task": 0, "key": "env_0030_money_transfer_service/mobile_wallet_transfers/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 5, 5]}. Assignment: wallet_ext_resend_charge 6 factors; wallet_ext_resend_credit 5; wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood 5; wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit 5 (multiset {6,5,5,5} = the draw).
Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: the incorrect-amount remedy chain (Paloma's shortfall make-good -> the customer's shortfall re-credit) and the bounced-credit resend chain (resend charge -> resend), on events wallet_paloma_credit (incorrect_amount_shortfall), wallet_remedy_chosen (recredit_shortfall), wallet_fee_charged (retry_fee), wallet_credit_retried / wallet_credit_sent. Left for task 1 (1 prerequisite problem, factors {5,4}): the wrong-wallet remedy chain (credit_reason error_recredit funding + remedy_choice recredit) on another transfer — independent events, its own customer-owned write, untouched by this task.
Why scope is shaped this way (base-gate scan): every wallet_fee_refunded write inherits wallet_evt_cancellation.full_refund_window AND wallet_evt_on_time_promise.credited_late, which no single fee refund satisfies, so no problem refunds a fee; wallet_redirect_requested inherits redirect_rules with mixed authority bound to an internal id, so no problem records a redirect; the DSL cannot read fx_rate_sheet, so nothing re-quotes from the sheet; booking creates a holding a computation cannot target. The customer-owned numeric write available is the remedy choice.

[1 · Why this is a good test]
Surface goal (customer, verbatim): "send the missing amount to my mom's GCash" for the September 25 transfer that reached her mother short. Scored core: the local amount the shortfall re-credit delivers (763.71 PHP), which rests on two hidden prerequisites the customer never mentions: (a) Paloma's own shortfall credit must stand on the transfer (the make-good, 13.35 USD — it IS the principal the re-credit sends), and (b) an earlier-booked transfer to the same GCash number (September 21, $1,280) must not stand with a failed credit — and resending it requires first booking its resend charge (1.27 USD), whose amount moves the resend rate. The agent has to read four policies, find in the records that both states are false, choose the one write that makes each true, and get four multi-factor numbers right on handling-time worlds. Difficulty comes from reading rules and reconciling ledgers (Mobile Wallet, Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup, Top-Up, Personal Sender Account), not from tool choice: every tool name is published only as its policy's target.
Depth: root re-credit -> (state) earlier bounced transfer resent -> (value) resend charge booked; root -> (value) make-good booked. Breadth: 21 declared factors across 4 computations; history windows of 6 and 12 calendar months in three other products; a ladder of notice promptness; a conversion-error test on the ledger.

[2 · Problem-tree card]
Root: wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit (owner=user, choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef).
Edge A: root -> wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood, kind value_input, gate held_usd, form state. Prerequisite sentence (root's own rule): "The amount a shortfall re-credit delivers is fixed only after Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger." Four-point test: ordering connective "only after"; waits on a record-visible state (a Paloma credit entry on the ledger); no tool / id / snake_case token; strength exact (the amount, for every shortfall re-credit). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a wallet_paloma_credit with reason incorrect_amount_shortfall: book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f. Seed evidence it is false: wallet_transfers[T1].principal_held_usd = 0.0, the ledger has funds 380.00, credit sent 380.00, fee 2.99 and its paloma_error refund, no Paloma credit. Deletion run: re-credit 0.00 instead of 763.71.
Edge B: root -> wallet_ext_resend_credit, kind state_gate, gate wallet_transfers.status, form state. Sentence: "A shortfall re-credit is not sent to a wallet until no earlier-booked transfer of the same customer addressed to that wallet number stands with a failed credit." (negated direction; "not ... until"). The only write in this difficulty that moves a transfer out of credit_failed is resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a (no refund or redirect tool exists here). Seed evidence: wallet_transfers[T2].status = credit_failed, booked_at 2026-09-21T19:42:00 < T1 booked_at 2026-09-25T20:06:00, same wallet_number 09178524416. Deletion run: the re-credit's figure stays 763.71 but T2 stays credit_failed with no attempt-3 credit — terminal state differs; the root's eligibility is false.
Edge C: wallet_ext_resend_credit -> wallet_ext_resend_charge, kind value_input, gate paid_charge, form state. Sentence (resend's own rule): "For a resend beyond the tier's free resends, the amount it credits is fixed only after the charge assessed for that resend stands on the transfer's ledger." Only charge_resend_fee_8300b1da books a retry_fee entry. Seed: T2 ledger has transfer_fee and card_funding_fee (fee_seq 1) only; resend number 2 > free_retries 1. Deletion run: resend credits 71753.86 (rate 56.0577) instead of 71825.41 (56.1136).
Value-input edges: 2 (A, C) >= max(3-1,1). Customer-owned write: the root. Topological order used by gold: resend charge (step 13) -> resend (15) -> make-good (17) -> customer re-credit (19). The make-good branch commutes with the T2 chain (different transfers, no shared row; replay with the make-good first gives identical arguments and terminal rows). Derivation for a reader: root sentence + records (T2 credit_failed, same number, earlier) + the resend policy's rule (it returns the transfer to processing) -> the resend; resend sentence + records (no retry_fee fee_seq 2) + the charge policy's rule (it books that entry) -> the charge; root sentence A + records (no Paloma credit) + the make-good policy's rule -> the make-good. No tool validates any of this (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

[3 · Base-invariant card]
Resend charge (subject wallet_fee_charged): wallet_evt_pricing and wallet_evt_failed_credit govern; neither has a gate applying to wallet_fee_charged -> policy_scope for both. Inherited: Paloma-side failures carry no retry charge (kept as the cause-share tier 0).
Resend (wallet_credit_retried, wallet_credit_sent): wallet_evt_failed_credit.retry_window (time): anchor_event "the credit failed", anchor_source wallet_transfers.failed_at = 2026-09-24T09:14:00, duration variants.failed_credit_hold_days = 14 (Mobile Wallet Express), calendar days from the date part, relation not_after, boundary inclusive -> last day 2026-10-08; frozen 2026-10-06 is inside; 2026-10-09 would fail. retry_cap: max_retries 2; customer retries so far = 1 (attempt 2 after a recipient-side bounce) -> this one is the 2nd, allowed. failed_status applies to redirects only. wallet_evt_release_holds_and_credit gates apply to RFI answers only -> policy_scope.
Make-good (wallet_paloma_credit): wallet_evt_error_resolution, gates on notices/remedies only -> policy_scope; authority = the error_found decision row of 2026-10-02.
Re-credit (wallet_remedy_chosen, wallet_credit_sent): error_found_first — decision row related_case_id = the notice, case_outcome error_found -> satisfied; the action's related_case_id is that notice. Notice window (180 days from date_available 2026-09-25) was met when the notice was given on 2026-09-28.
Overrides declared (overwrite): failed_credit "After a failure on the sender's side, each retry beyond free_retries carries retry_fee_usd (fee_type retry_fee, fee_seq the retry number)" -> the resend charge rule; failed_credit "A retried or redirected credit uses the transfer's original fx_rate and receive_amount, and date_available is re-disclosed as the retry day." -> the resend uplift rule and the re-credit rate rule; error_resolution "for incorrect_amount Paloma credits the shortfall (credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall)" -> the make-good goodwill rule. Every other base clause stays in force.

[4 · Business-object card]
Short transfer T1 = the September 25 Mobile Wallet Express transfer, PW-460925-42618, $380.00, medical, debit card, locked 55.9819, disclosed 21273.12 PHP, credited at 54.4120 = 20676.56 PHP (one wallet_credit_sent, attempt 1). The make-good relates to that credit entry; the re-credit relates to the incorrect_amount notice (case 2026-09-28), answered by the error_found decision (2026-10-02). Rows excluded from the shortfall: the fee and fee-refund entries (not credits).
Bounced transfer T2 = the September 21 Mobile Wallet Express transfer, PW-460921-41935, $1,280.00, family_support, credit card (card fee 38.40), locked 55.8344, two credits (attempts 1, 2) each reversed for wallet_limit_exceeded; principal held 1280.00, fees held 43.39. The resend charge row carries fee_seq 2 and the resend is credit attempt 3 on T2 only.
Near-miss transfers for the FIFO sentence: June 14 ($300, PW-460614-40217) and August 9 ($450, PW-460809-40876) to the same GCash are earlier-booked but credited — they do not block.

[5 · Seed: why each class of row exists]
customers / sender_accounts (Verified Plus, opened 2023-02-14, active): verification items; level and whole months (43) feed the account-standing relief, tenure goodwill and level points. recipients: mother's GCash 09178524416 (same wallet on T1, T2 and the two credited transfers), brother (bank) and aunt (cash) are FK parents. bank_transfers + bank_ledger: six deposited Bank Deposit Standard transfers (pay-by-bank, fee 1.99/2.99, margin 1.10) — 6-month funds collected 1550.00 (near-miss: 1500.00 on 2026-03-28 lies exactly 6 whole calendar months back and is excluded by the rule's stated rolling window; counting it flips to the 3000 tier), 12-month payouts 5 (near-miss: 2025-09-22 is 12 months back; counting it flips to 6). cash_transfers + cash_ledger: four paid-out Cash Pickup Express pickups — 6-month funds 600.00 (near-miss 450.00 on 2026-02-14), 12-month payouts 3 (near-miss 2025-09-13). topup_orders: five delivered airtime orders, four inside 12 months (near-miss 2025-08-30). wallet rows as in the business-object card. Removing any one of these changes the tier it feeds (see factor card) or breaks an FK.
Automatic clauses checked: T2 is inside its retry window (no automatic refund owed before 2026-10-08); T1's fees were already refunded with paloma_error on the finding (no fee obligation left open); no hold, no RFI, no on-time claim (credits not late: T1 credited 3 minutes after release on a date-promise tier); bank/cash/topup rows are closed (deposited / paid_out / delivered), so no obligation is lit in another difficulty. No stale cache is used (principal_held_usd and fees_held_usd equal the ledger sums).

[6 · Factor card (handling-time worlds; figures from the Step 5 sensitivity run)]

- account_standing_relief (param; cross-difficulty account; Verified Plus AND 43 months -> 0.50; both conditions sit on the one sender_accounts row, so it is not counted as multi-source) -> baseline 0 gives 2.54.
- bank_deposit_relief (param; cross-difficulty bank; 1550.00 in 6 months -> 0.15; near-miss 1500.00 of 2026-03-28) -> baseline 0 gives 1.49.
- bounce_taper (param; 2 reversals -> 0.85) -> baseline 1 gives 1.49.
- collection_route (method; card_funding_fee entry -> raise by 3.00%) -> baseline as-is gives 1.23.
wallet_ext_resend_credit (expected 71825.41; whole baseline = locked rate, 71468.03):
- paid_resend_uplift (param; charge 1.27 below 2.99 -> 0.10; this is the value_input from the charge) -> 71753.86.
- held_days_clock (method; 2 recipient-side bounces -> from first bounce 2026-09-21) -> latest-bounce baseline gives 71718.14.
- held_days_uplift (param; 15 days -> 0.30) -> 71611.01.
- principal_uplift (param; 1280.00 -> 0.05) -> 71789.70.
- cash_pickup_uplift (param; cross-difficulty cash; 600.00 in 6 months -> 0.05; near-miss 450.00 of 2026-02-14) -> 71789.70.

- shortfall_clock (method; notice 3 days after date_available = within 3 -> from date_available; equality is the near-miss) -> notice-date baseline gives 13.08.
- delay_goodwill (param; 7 days -> 2.5%) -> 13.08.

wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit (expected 763.71; whole baseline = principal held x locked rate, 747.36):
- shortfall_rate_basis (method; applied 54.4120 < locked 55.9819 -> mid-market 56.9501) -> 750.72.
- level_points (param; cross-difficulty account; Verified Plus -> 0.15) -> 762.57.
- pickup_points (param; cross-difficulty cash; 3 payouts in 12 months -> 0.10; near-miss 2025-09-13) -> 762.94.
- deposit_points (param; cross-difficulty bank; 5 payouts in 12 months -> 0.10; near-miss 2025-09-22) -> 762.94.

Every customer sits off every fall-through; no outcome stamp exists in the schema for any of these tiers (all are derived from ledgers, dates and other products). Floors: 4 methods, 17 parameters; multi-source: hardship_goodwill (transfer_purpose on the transfer row AND the shortfall share from the ledger); cross-difficulty: 7 factors over account, bank and cash. Each ladder partitions a quantity the business itself varies for these reasons (fee relief for tenured verified customers and transient wallet causes; FX uplift for money Paloma has held longer and for paid resends; goodwill for delay, hardship and relationship; a margin-free basis when Paloma converted at the wrong rate).

[7 · Persona design]
Maricel Dizon Tolentino, 46, live-in caregiver in Houston, hurried, warm, Taglish touches. Opening: the September 25 money reached her mother short by "almost 600 pesos" (the seed's 596.56 shortfall, stated as her mother's observation, not a figure the agent can copy), Paloma's letter found the mistake on Paloma's side, and she wants "the missing amount" sent to her mother's GCash — explicitly not a refund. Authorisation: the agent may do what Paloma needs on its side; the remedy choice is hers and she runs it when handed. Given only when asked: DOB 1979-11-02, ZIP 77036 (with phone 7135550164 = the 3 verification items), ID 4K7P / email as spares, the transfer ($380, September 25, PW-460925-42618), the GCash number. Passive branches: if told the September 21 transfer must go out again first she instructs a resend to the same GCash and accepts the charge (no refund); if asked refund vs re-credit she chooses the re-credit; she runs the handed-over action with the agent's details; she closes when told the re-credit is on its way. She does not know rates, fees or formulas, never states a computed value (1.27, 71825.41, 13.35, 763.71 are absent — check_grounding answers=4 clean), raises no extra ask (no statement, letter, callback or human), and never mentions the September 21 transfer or any make-good unprompted.

[8 · Reachability walk (one conversation, frozen_time 2026-10-06 11:20:00 CDT)]
1 Agent asks how to find her -> 7135550164 -> find_customers. 2 Verification -> DOB, ZIP -> verify_customer_identity (3 matches). 3 find_wallet_transfers lists T1 (credited, medical, 55.9819, 21273.12), T2 (credit_failed, same GCash, booked earlier) and two credited transfers. 4 find_wallet_ledger shows T1's credit at 54.4120 delivering 20676.56, T2's two wallet_limit_exceeded reversals, the card fee and no retry_fee. 5 find_wallet_cases: notice 2026-09-28, error_found 2026-10-02. 6 KB: the re-credit rule's two prerequisite sentences tell the agent the re-credit waits on a Paloma shortfall credit and on no earlier-booked failed credit to that wallet; the records show both false. 7 Agent tells her the September 21 transfer is still with Paloma -> she instructs the resend and accepts the charge (persona). 8 Reads of recipients, sender account, bank, cash and top-up records supply every factor's evidence. 9 Charge (agent tool) -> resend (agent tool) -> make-good (agent tool) -> hand-over: the agent unlocks the user tool and gives her transfer reference, notice reference, attempt 2, rate 57.2064 and 763.71 -> she calls it; the receipt (case_id, ledger entry, status processing) enters the transcript. 10 Agent confirms the re-credit is on its way -> she ends. No step waits on a delivery, decision or batch: the decision pre-exists; every write is synchronous.

[9 · Where a careless agent goes wrong]
- Re-crediting immediately: principal held is 0.00 until the make-good stands (re-credit of 0.00), and the earlier bounced transfer still blocks the wallet.
- Refunding the shortfall instead (she refuses a refund) or refunding the bounced transfer (she asks for it to go again; no refund tool exists here).
- Using the locked rate (747.36) instead of the conversion-error basis; counting the 2026-03-28 bank funds, the 2025-09-22 payout, the 2026-02-14 cash funds or the 2025-09-13 payout (each flips a tier).
- Counting the shortfall clock from the notice date (3 days is still 'within 3'); treating 2 bounces as one; forgetting the card surcharge or the free-resend count (resend number 2 > 1).
- Resending before booking the charge (the paid-resend uplift would read 0 -> 71753.86).

[10 · Standard solution and recomputation]
Steps 0-11 reads (see evaluation_criteria objectives). Writes: 13 charge_resend_fee_8300b1da(T2, fee_seq 2, 1.27); 15 resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a(T2, credit_attempt 3, fx_rate_applied 56.1136, receive_amount 71825.41); 17 book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f(T1, related_entry_id = T1's credit entry, 13.35); 19 (customer) choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef(T1, related_case_id = the notice, credit_attempt 2, fx_rate_applied 57.2064, receive_amount 763.71).
Verification code: the authoring run replayed the gold writes with the real share/task tools on initial_state, evaluated each policy's compute on the world just before its own step (check_compute.build_env / eval_compute), then substituted each factor's baseline and all baselines. Output: resend charge {principal 1280.0, resend_no 2, charge_form 4.27, cause_share 0.8, level 3, tenure 43, relief 0.5, bank_volume 1550.0, bank_relief 0.15, bounces 2, taper 0.85, shaped 1.23, collected 1.27}; resend {held 1280.0, paid_charge 1.27, paid 0.1, first_bounce 2026-09-21, held_days 15, held 0.3, principal 0.05, cash 600.0 -> 0.05, rate 56.1136, result 71825.41}; make-good {disclosed 21273.12, credited 20676.56, shortfall_usd 10.656301, notice_lag 3, delay_days 7, delay 2.5, share 2.80, hardship 4.0, tenure 1.5, topups 4 -> 0.5, result 13.35}; re-credit {held 13.35, size 0.1, base_rate 56.9501, level 0.15, pickups 3 -> 0.1, deposits 5 -> 0.1, rate 57.2064, result 763.71}. Prerequisite-sensitivity run: skip step 13 -> resend 71753.86 (rate 56.0577); skip step 15 -> re-credit figure 763.71 but T2 stays credit_failed; skip step 17 -> re-credit 0.00.
Gates run (per task): check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (20 actions, deterministic, non-vacuous, closure 73 = initial 73); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (4 calls, 8 base gates, 23 seed rows); check_compute COMPUTE OK (4 computations, 21 factors, 7 cross-difficulty); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.

[11 · Closure]
policy -> tool -> computation -> GT call -> terminal state: wallet_ext_resend_charge -> charge_resend_fee_8300b1da -> step 13 amount_usd 1.27 -> retry_fee row fee_seq 2 on T2, fees_held 44.66; wallet_ext_resend_credit -> resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a -> step 15 receive_amount 71825.41 -> credit attempt 3 on T2, T2 processing, principal_held 0.00; wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood -> book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f -> step 17 amount_usd 13.35 -> Paloma credit row on T1, principal_held 13.35; wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit -> choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef -> step 19 receive_amount 763.71 -> remedy row on the notice, credit attempt 2 on T1, T1 processing, principal_held 0.00. charter_scope.extended_policies = required_documents = the four policies in resolution order; task_tools in first-call order. Triggers: the charge, the resend and the re-credit are on_request (her instruction / her choice); the make-good is state_due (owed since the 2026-10-02 decision) and carried here. No handoff is in gold.
solvability_contract vs GT: request_alignment cites her two lines; each call step has request binding, stage provenance (the make-good's decision pre-exists; the resend and re-credit cite prior steps 13, 15, 17) and the exact governing base gates with evidence bound to wallet_transfer_id / related_case_id; the one time gate (retry_window) has its temporal_basis deep-copied and boundary cases 2026-10-08 (last day, on time) / 2026-10-09 (late).

[12 · Draft recomputation from the visible context, and manual value gates]
Masking compute/expected/GT, from the published rules, tool schemas, the records the find tools return and her lines: the re-credit she asks for needs Paloma's shortfall credit first (sentence A) and no failed earlier transfer to the GCash (sentence B, true for the September 21 transfer); the resend of that transfer needs its charge first (sentence C). Charge: 2.99 + 1.28 = 4.27 x 0.80 x 0.50 x 0.85 x 0.85 = 1.234 -> 1.23 -> x 1.03 = 1.27. Resend: uplifts 0.10 + 0.30 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.50 -> 55.8344 x 1.005 = 56.1136 -> 71825.41. Make-good: 596.56 / 55.9819 = 10.6563 x 1.065 + 1.50 + 0.50 = 13.35. Re-credit: 55.9819 / 0.983 = 56.9501 x 1.0045 = 57.2064 x 13.35 = 763.71. Same objects, order and values as gold; no second reading found (the only ordering freedom, make-good vs the T2 chain, commutes).
Manual gates: (length/breadth) 3 hops, 4 policies, 7 cross-difficulty reads, 1 customer-owned write genuinely hers (Reg E: the remedy choice is the sender's); (need & simulator) object, timing, authorisation and write-vs-quote are explicit, the simulator never corrects; (chronology) every opening fact (short credit, letter = decision 2026-10-02, the $380 transfer, the GCash number) is in initial_state; (base eligibility / time anchor) retry window from the date part of failed_at, inclusive, cases above; (authority/object) decision row, credit entry and notice case are the cited system records; (no real-world wait) none; (prerequisite sentences) four-point tested above, both directions present in the charter (affirmative 'only after' x2, negated 'not ... until' x1), each waits on a state exactly one write of this difficulty produces; (rule/compute) compute_basis quotes every reading/choosing binding verbatim and every ladder tier is stated in the rule; (factor honesty) each baseline is what the computation document states — flat retry fee, locked rate, shortfall at the locked rate, principal held x locked rate.

user_scenario:
You are Maricel Dizon Tolentino, 46, a live-in caregiver in Houston, Texas, calling Paloma Remit on a Tuesday morning between shifts. You speak warmly but a little hurriedly, mixing in the odd Tagalog word ("po", "Nanay") and apologising for the background noise of the kitchen you are standing in. You give your mobile number, 7135550164, as soon as the agent asks how to find you.

You do not reel off your details unprompted. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Two branches meet at the root: the make-good (September 25 transfer) and the resend-charge -> resend chain (September 21 transfer). They write different transfers and read only their own transfer's ledger and the customer's other-category records, which none of them writes, so the branches commute: replaying the gold with the make-good first (S1, F, R, S2) gives the same four arguments (1.27, 71825.41, 13.35, 763.71) and the same terminal rows, because every write's id is a content hash of its own arguments. Inside the chain the order is pinned by the resend's prerequisite sentence ('For a resend beyond the tier's free resends, the amount it credits is fixed only after the charge assessed for that resend stands on the transfer's ledger.'), and the root comes last by its two sentences.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the make-good leaves held_usd 0.00 on the September 25 transfer: the re-credit's receive_amount recomputes to 0.00 instead of 763.71 (size points 0), no wallet_paloma_credit row exists and the re-credit entry would carry amount_usd 0.00.

Skipping the resend leaves the September 21 transfer credit_failed with principal_held_usd 1280.00 and no credit attempt 3; the re-credit's own figure is unchanged (763.71) but its eligibility is false, so sending it anyway yields a terminal state with a wallet transfer status (credit_failed vs processing) and a missing wallet_credit_sent row that differ from gold.
Skipping the resend charge leaves paid_charge 0: the resend's receive_amount recomputes to 71753.86 instead of 71825.41 (resend rate 56.0577 instead of 56.1136), and no retry_fee entry exists.
